what: Blackstone is the world's largest manager of alternative investments: private equity, real estate, private credit and hedge-fund solutions. It earns management fees and a share of profits.
customers: Pension funds, sovereign funds, insurers and wealthy individuals.
moat: A top brand and track record that attract capital, and scale that gives access to the largest deals.
risks: Fewer asset sales when markets are weak
Withdrawals from funds sold to individuals
opportunities: Operating margin of 47% with return on invested capital of 26%
Fee-paying assets under management keep growing, which is what drives earnings
Wealthy individual investors are a large new source of capital for private markets
watch: Fee-related earnings and net inflows into its funds.
